summary.text: Customers find these wireless earbuds offer good sound quality, secure fit that stays in place well, and quick battery charging. Moreover, they appreciate the value for money, with one customer noting they're better than Beats headphones. However, reliability and connectivity receive mixed feedback - while some say they work well, others report issues with one side not working and Bluetooth connectivity problems. Additionally, durability is also mixed, with some saying they last for hours while others report them breaking after three months of use.
